item.title: March First Friday
item.description: As we shift ever closer to spring, creativity abounds and Homer galleries and art spaces showcase work by local and statewide artists, as well as live art activities including music and ceramics. Take the opportunity to stroll downtown, meet artists and enjoy the variety of mediums on display.

item.title: ‘What’s in a name?’: Reviving a forgotten past — Part 4
item.description: AUTHOR’S NOTE: This is the fourth in a multi-part series about Kenai Peninsula places and landmarks that once had different names. Previously, the series has discussed Cooper Landing and Tern Lake.

item.title: Best Bets
item.description: The Betster is grateful for the sunshine that has graced us this past week, but if the temperatures could get on board with being a little above freezing, that’d be great too. Still, it’s a lovely time to be out and about, and as always, there’s plenty to do and see around town. For details on upcoming events, check out these Best Bets.

item.title: Death notice: Mary Katzke
item.description: Mary Roseanne Katzke passed on Jan. 13, 2026, in Buenos Aires, Argentina. A memorial service is being held at 820 Soundview Avenue in Homer on May 30 from 1-4 p.m. Bench dedication at Bishop’s Beach at 4:30 p.m. For more information please visit Mary’s Celebration of Life Facebook event or email gsartman@gmail.com.
